title: EventEnvelope
description: The one envelope every cross-module message carries (event-conventions.md EV-2). It is the serialised form of common.outbox_message.payload (ERD D-17). `data` is the event-specific body whose schema is named by eventType and schemaVersion.

eventType.description: <ProducerModule>.<EventName>, EventName in past tense for facts (EV-1)

schemaVersion.description: Version of the data schema for this eventType (EV-7)

idempotencyKey.description: The producer's natural key for this occurrence (EV-4); never the HTTP Idempotency-Key and never the correlationId

occurredAt.description: UTC, when the fact was committed by the producer

correlationId.description: Carried from the originating request (api-conventions R-42)

causationId.description: eventId of the event whose handling produced this one; null when produced by a request

userId.description: User.id, including service principals (ERD D-2); null only for INTEGRATION

subject.description: The aggregate the event is about, as an opaque reference (M-4, D-15)

revisionNo.description: Present for every revisioned aggregate (D-15); consumers reject a stale revision

scope.description: Authorization and routing anchors supplied by the producer (M-7)

data.description: Event-specific body; schema '<eventType>.v<schemaVersion>' (EV-3). Identifiers and facts only, never a sensitive value, never a full aggregate.
